meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后，你的 AI 助手会接入 Linear 的评论系统：每当有人在指定团队的 issue 下留评论，它就会自动参与讨论并作出回应，不需要 @ 它。每次评论都会触发，并按 issue 分别建立独立对话。
howto.when: 当有人在你配置的 Linear 团队的任意 issue 下发表评论时触发，无需 @。

say.text: 请分析这个 issue 的根因，并给出排查建议。
say.note: agent 会读取评论上下文并回复。

say.text: 总结这个 issue 的讨论，列出待办事项。
帮我评估这个修复方案是否可行。
say.note: agent 会基于评论内容给出意见。

howto.what_en: After installation, your AI assistant is connected to Linear's comment system: every comment on an issue in the configured team triggers it to join and respond — no @-mention needed. Each issue thread becomes a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: It triggers when a comment is posted on any issue in the specified Linear team. No @-mention is required.

say_en.text: Analyze the root cause of this issue and suggest next steps.
say_en.note: The agent will read the thread and reply.

say_en.text: Summarize this issue's discussion and list action items.
Review this proposed fix and give your opinion.
say_en.note: It will respond based on the comments.
